rule_definitions.ancestry_three_oracle: Three fixed weighted initial-profile columns: leaf0/1, leaf2/3, proximal4/5. Current exact path projected by least squares per example; soma1.
rule_definitions.ancestry_two_leaf_oracle_unit_proximal: Only the two fixed weighted leaf columns use current exact-field projection coefficients. Proximal q_4=q_5=1,soma1. This is two oracle-controlled distal profiles plus a fixed common proximal rule, not an entirely two-column dictionary over all6sites or a local encoder.
rule_definitions.calibrated_broadcast: Fixed mean initial exact six-site path profile from512 separate unlabeled samples; soma multiplier1. Calibration is oracle-informed.
rule_definitions.exact: Current seven-site exact path derivative times scalar soma error; explicit oracle comparator.
rule_definitions.hard_distal_and_proximal: Hard distal gate also multiplies corresponding proximal q_p. This intentionally flawed control keeps24trainable parameter slots but makes proximal-inhibitory gradients identically zero because their local eligibility requires inhibited activity; it is NOT described as preserving effective plasticity of all24parameters.
rule_definitions.hard_distal_unit_proximal: Distal q_j=1[a_parent(j)==0], proximal q_4=q_5=1,soma q_6=1. Coefficients use only imposed local inhibitory activity/context, no exact paths or initial profile. All24slots are plastic and proximal inhibition can learn.
rule_definitions.shunt_proportional_unit_proximal: Secondary supplied local conductance rule: distal q_j=1/(1+g_I,parent*a_parent), proximal and soma1. Leak is1; intentionally omits daughter-coupling denominator, downstream soma gain and exact path. Does not require teacher parameters.
rule_definitions.swapped_distal_unit_proximal: Distal q_j=1[a_parent(j)>0], proximal and soma1. Same gate bandwidth and eligibility, reversed assignment.
rule_definitions.unit_broadcast: Unit voltage-credit multiplier at all sites, retaining exact local eligibility.
